contexts: 620-bed teaching hospital, 16 adult wards with badges
silent monitoring under staff council agreement JSC-2026-07
board decision on the feedback licence by June 2027
reading: Real-time feedback acts on the badge figure directly and on hand hygiene only through staff behaviour, so the system's own compliance figure can rise without cleaner hands. Visible observation changes behaviour, float staff carry feedback between wards, and infections are too rare to be the outcome. The design problem is therefore measurement and contamination, not the intervention.
